scripts.release:ci: pnpm run check && pnpm release:pack-check && pnpm release:publish --tag next
scripts.diagnose:render: pnpm --filter @ritojs/core-wasm build && pnpm --filter @ritojs/core build && pnpm --filter @ritojs/core run build:reference && node packages/rito/scripts/render-diagnostic-case.mjs
scripts.diagnose:reader-parity: pnpm --filter @ritojs/core-wasm build && pnpm --filter @ritojs/core build && pnpm --filter @ritojs/core run build:reference && RITO_DIAG_ENGINE=both node packages/rito/scripts/render-diagnostic-case.mjs
scripts.rust:check: pnpm run rust:fmt:check && pnpm run rust:clippy && pnpm run rust:test
scripts.rust:parity:fast: pnpm run rust:fmt:check && pnpm run rust:clippy && pnpm run rust:fixtures:check && pnpm run rust:runtime-parity && pnpm run rust:wasm:check && pnpm --filter @ritojs/core-wasm run test
scripts.rust:parity:full: pnpm run rust:fmt:check && pnpm run rust:clippy && pnpm run rust:fixtures:check && pnpm run rust:fixture-parity:full && pnpm run rust:runtime-parity:full && pnpm run rust:wasm:verify
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run bootstrap:core-wasm && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run bootstrap:core-wasm && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @ritojs/core test:unit && pnpm --filter @ritojs/kit test && pnpm --filter @ritojs/react test
scripts.test:golden:pixel: pnpm --filter @ritojs/core build && pnpm --filter @ritojs/core run build:reference && RITO_PIXEL_GOLDEN=1 playwright test -c packages/rito/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:golden:pixel:update: pnpm --filter @ritojs/core build && pnpm --filter @ritojs/core run build:reference && RITO_PIXEL_GOLDEN=1 RITO_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 playwright test -c packages/rito/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run bootstrap:core-wasm && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present run test:coverage
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run bootstrap:core-wasm && pnpm run css:contract:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:golden:books && pnpm run test:golden:render && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @ritojs/core run test:dom-free:reference
